in_marathi.name: Baalaark
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baalaark हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baalaark is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bala' meaning 'Lord' and 'Ark' meaning 'Cows'. This name is associated with Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector and nurturer of cows. The name symbolizes strength, compassion, and prosperity.
